objective: Ask the cheapest scientifically useful real-data question first: can any pre-race model reproducibly improve probability quality over the market and simple structural controls under one strict temporal evaluator?
eligible_feature_source: Only PRE/decision-available fields with timestamp/provenance proof; RESULT and PAYOUT are excluded.

baseline_candidates.name: MARKET_ONLY
baseline_candidates.description: Normalize timestamp-proven market implied probabilities available at the declared cutoff; serves as the first external competitor, not as ground truth.

baseline_candidates.name: SIMPLE_SCORE
baseline_candidates.description: Basic pre-race competition score/profile variables only; no tactical labels, no market residual tuning.

baseline_candidates.name: TABULAR_SIMPLE
baseline_candidates.description: Simple GBDT-family candidate such as LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost using a frozen PRE feature subset; algorithm choice must be verified and prespecified before execution.

baseline_candidates.name: PLACKETT_LUCE_STRUCTURAL_CONTROL
baseline_candidates.description: Existing structural null/control; not presumed final top3 generator.

baseline_candidates.name: LINE_AWARE_SIMPLE
baseline_candidates.description: Existing line-augmented simple candidate using only PRE line structure with provenance.

baseline_candidates.name: CONDITIONAL_TOP3
baseline_candidates.description: Existing conditional top3 architecture candidate; same evaluation bench, no synthetic success credit.

baseline_candidates.name: GNN_PROTOTYPE
baseline_candidates.description: Rider=node and line/position/relationship=edge representation candidate; architecture hypothesis only, not preferred a priori.

market_comparison.primary_question: Does a candidate improve proper-scoring probability quality relative to the market-only baseline out of sample under identical cutoff semantics?
market_comparison.secondary_question: Where candidate and market disagree, is the disagreement temporally and regime stable?

prespecified_failure_conditions: candidate cannot emit valid normalized probability object
candidate requires architecture-specific race exclusions not declared before scoring
apparent gain vanishes across temporal blocks or is dominated by a tiny subgroup without predeclared support
calibration materially worsens despite rank improvement
sample_size_rule: Report race count and effective evaluation support for every metric and subgroup. Do not treat a small positive difference as reproducible signal without uncertainty and stability evidence.
tactical_feature_rule: BANTE_FOLLOW/INITIATIVE_CONFLICT are excluded from real baseline inputs until independent duplicate annotation reliability is completed and separately admitted.
next_gate: Implement non-protected harness contracts for M0/S0/C0 first; verify real PRE and market point-in-time source availability before any real scoring execution.
